facts.business: City Pulse Multiventures Limited operates an OTT platform named WOWPLEX and is expanding into multiplex cinema screens in Ahmedabad.

capacity_or_capex.item: 2 screens at Iskcon Circle, SG Highway, Ahmedabad

auditor.name: M/s Rajendra J. Shah & Co., Chartered Accountants

key_risks: Regulatory risk for OTT platforms under IT Act and potential government regulation
Non-compliance with BSE filing requirements (integrated governance report delay leading to fines)
Dependence on digital infrastructure and consumer data privacy concerns
facts.related_party_note: During the year, there were some transactions entered with related parties referred to in Section 188(1) of the Companies Act, 2013 read with Rule 8(2) of Companies (Accounts) Rules, 2014. Form AOC-2 has been annexed to the Report as Annexure-II.
